text:
sre-bot: ALERT: 3 containers restarted on gpu-pool-12 in cluster-prod-2 due to OOM during prefill for model redwood-13b-v2. Error signature: 'cudaErrorMemoryAllocation' + kernel crash. Auto-escalating to #incidents and paging oncall.

maria_g: seeing the same — spike in prefill mem usage from long-context requests around 12.3k tokens. Container restarts started at ~1711002300.

kevin_s: oncall here. paging now. any obvious customer  impact?

support-ops: repros show increased 502s for a handful of customers using long_context=true. We have alerts from frontend indicating degraded tail latency and retries. Opening support cases for customers: AcmeAnalytics and WriteFlow.

jess_lee: attaching log snippet from pod redwood-serving-78f4: ```
[2026-02-25T12:05:02Z] prefill: seq_len=12300, requested_prefill=13000
[2026-02-25T12:05:03Z] allocate_tensor failed: cudaMalloc returned out of memory
[2026-02-25T12:05:03Z] container: process killed by OOM
[2026-02-25T12:05:04Z] kubelet: restarting container```

kevin_s: ok. quick mitigations we can do immediately?

maria_g: two immediate things: 1) route long-context requests to redwood-13b-v2-quant (quantized smaller memory) 2) enable gateway prefill trim to cap prefill to 8k tokens for requests > 8k. Both are config changes we can do without redeploying model binaries.

alex_p: I can push a routing rule to traffic-proxy. Patch suggestion: ```PATCH /routes/traffic
{ "condition": "request.context_tokens > 8192", "model": "redwood-13b-v2-quant" }```

eng-infra-bot: Runbook step triggered: dump kernel logs and mark node for postmortem. Use `kubectl logs -p <pod>` and `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY` on node.

kevin_s: do the routing change. maria, can you toggle prefill trim in gateway?

maria_g: on it. applying gate config: `PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192` to gateway v2; will patch via k8s configmap and rolling restart of 2 gateway pods. ETA ~ 4m.

deploy-bot: Rolling update started for gateway-config (2/2 pods).

jess_lee: also bumping the model-level eviction threshold to allow more aggressive KV cache eviction during prefill spikes: set EVICT_KV_THRESHOLD=0.6. Pushing as hot-config to serving runtime.

support-ops: notifying impacted customers via incident channel. Draft message posted to status page: "We are investigating elevated errors for long-context requests. Mitigation in progress."

kevin_s: while those roll, we should cordon the node that had repeated restarts and recreate pods on other nodes to avoid repeated crashes. maria, please add node to unschedulable and drain.

maria_g: cordoning node gpu-node-47 now. drain started. draining will evict running pods — some will restart on other nodes.

jess_lee: after routing rule and prefill trim, observed immediate drop in OOMs on the cluster; a couple of pod restarts still in backlog but no new crashes in last 180s.

kevin_s: good. keep monitoring for 15m. also we need a temporary rate limit to reduce burst of long-context requests. alex, can you add a per-minute cap for requests where context_tokens>8192?

alex_p: yes, adding rule `rate_limit_long_context: 10/min` for all tenants. Pushing now.

eng-infra-bot: Metrics: prefill_memory_avg per-GPU dropped from 92% -> 68% after changes. OOM restart count reduced from 12/hr -> 1/hr.

support-ops: Customer update sent to AcmeAnalytics: "We've applied mitigations to reduce memory pressure for long-context workloads. You may see degraded tail latency while we rebalance traffic; we will follow up with a post-incident summary."

kevin_s: summary of immediate actions: 1) routing rule for contexts>8192 -> redwood-13b-v2-quant 2) gateway PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192 3) rate limit long-context at 10/min 4) node cordoned and pods drained 5) eviction threshold lowered. All rolled in last 10m.

jess_lee: for next steps: collect full logs, GPU mem traces, and attach to incident. We should plan a postmortem with remediation: longer-term: either increase default prefill trimming, introduce adaptive KV eviction earlier, or add model admission control per-request context size.

maria_g: creating pager handoff notes and linking runbook. Handing off to night oncall.

kevin_s: thanks team. handoff to next oncall @jess_lee in 30 min. Open action items: - postmortem owner: jess_lee - follow-up: engineering to evaluate admission control - Product/Support to notify any customers needing SLA credit.

jess_lee: acknowledged. I'll own the postmortem. tagging eng-sre and runtime for root cause analysis.

deploy-bot: Incident thread archived to /incidents/1711002345 when last action complete.

maria_g: last check: no new OOMs for 12m, traffic steady. closing paging for now.

kevin_s: ending handoff — oncall clear. :white_check_mark:
